# Video screening fixture

`clothed-camera.jpg` is a resized version of scikit-image's astronaut test image, depicting NASA astronaut Eileen Collins in a spacesuit. It is only used for synthetic camera tests, never a member profile.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.24.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png

Source project documentation: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut
